title: Frozen spec's Design Notes + Verification still list lose among 'must stay pixel-identical' T2 demos, contradicting its own Boundaries cause-doc (which this chunk correctly follows)
evidence: Line 33 (Boundaries): "lose.dem (its own stuck packet — the demo's scenario IS the strain: the residential telegraphs 🔴, cause-documented); boot/draw/flow/win/bundle/ecmp/place/demolish T2s stay pixel-identical — the negative proof)". Line 95 (Design Notes): "Every one is cause-documented; boot/draw/place/flow/win/lose/ecmp/bundle/demolish T2s must stay pixel-identical (the negative proof). A shift with NO cause = STOP + flag.". Line 106 (Verification): "`tools/harness.sh save boot draw place flow win lose ecmp bundle demolish` -- must be T2 no-ops (pixel-identical; `.t1`/`.log.bin` re-bless only)".
detail: The re-bless itself is correct (verified: lose/03000ms.png is the only light-demo PNG in the diff; pixel diff = red ring + `!!` glyph on the left residential node, exactly the documented stuck-packet telegraph), but the spec's Design Notes/Verification sentences still exclude lose from the shift set — stale prose that would mislead a future re-bless minion running the documented verification command.
recommended_fix: Amend spec-4-1-warning-forecast.md lines 95 and 106: remove `lose` from the 'must stay pixel-identical' list and the save no-op command, mirroring line 33's cause-documented set.
